text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--- A survey of 37 building sites in Copenhagen shows that two out of three building sites have safety problems. Only 11 sites met present safety rules.
--- Minister of social affairs Karen Jespersen is to launch the second part of a new social security act allowing privatisation of social services to a larger extend than before.
--- Biotech company Novo Nordisk now has applied for 200 patents since introducing a new patent strategy more than one year ago. JYLLANDS POSTEN

--- A survey made by the international analysis institute ISR in 17 countries shows that the Danish employees are more satisfied with their jobs than other Scandinavians.In Europe as a whole the Danes take second place to the Swiss.
--- Danish villages are to join together in an association of 105 local authorities with the idea of forming a development fund for rural areas.
